english: We part here.
We'll meet again, right?
Hmm, duuunno☆\nWell, bye-nara.
//Eve vanishes in a flash of light.
You really are, to the very end...
'Mysteries stay mysteries, waiting for their time,' huh.\nI wonder if everyone will accept that...
//END
Woo! Feels like coming home after so long!
Not unlike our world, maybe?
It's my first time in Hibiki-chan's world!
I fought Tsubasa here. Back then, who'd have thought\nwe'd end up fighting side by side.
Fighting humans feels foolish\nwhen we're fighting the Noise,\nbut it never quite works out that way.
But I believe humans can\nunderstand each other!
...I was forcefully convinced\nby such pretty words.\nThat's exactly why you're my bride.
Can't that 'bride' thing\njust be 'friends'...?
Isn't it Japanese culture?
Ah! Looks like Houki-san and the others are here!
Heey! Houki-chaan!
I told you before not to shout!\nHonestly, you never learn...
Looks like you were doing fine,\nno need to have worried!
Of course!
Aria-san, you saw your mother after so long.\nHow was it?
Well, it's both motivation\nand the anxious feeling that I have to do something.
So Dejiko, how was going back?\nI thought once you went home\nthat'd be the last of you.
Usada took Puchiko away, nyo.\nTo take her back,\nthe journey continues a bit longer, nyo.
Puchiko-san... that's terrible.
Um... would you like\na hot-spring manju?
Nyo!? What is this, nyo!?
Hot-spring manju?
Not THOSE buns, nyo!!\nI'm asking what those 'strongest boobs I ever designed'\nthings are, nyo!!
Huh...?
No can do, Dejikoo. These are mine!\nI won't let you touchh!
Ah...
//Tiffania flees Mion and hides behind Dejiko.
What even IS this picture, nyo!?
(A scheming petit knight\nprotecting a busty beauty from a molester, perhaps?)
(I don't understand at all, but...)
[CLAUDE]-san,\nhave you seen Teach, desuu?
[CLAUDE]-kun,\ndid you see Teach?
Eve-san?\nCome to think of it, she's nowhere to be seen...
Don't tell me she slipped away\nwithout a word again, desuu?\nAfter we finally found her...
Sheesh! Did her curiosity explode again\nand she wandered off somewhere!?\nHonestly, Teach!!
With the [NOEL] thing too,\nI'm worried, desuu...
I doubt it, but...\nmaybe she went to [MERU]...?
//SFX: booming attack sounds. Usada's army attacks.\n//Screen shake and other effects.
An attack!? We just got here!?
This is...!
Seems my prediction was right!
O-hohohoho!!\nLong time no see, you lot!!
Ah, it's the bunny who failed\nto take over Gamers!
Ugh, you tried to take over THAT?\nAnd failed? How embarrassing...
People from a world without TV, shut it!
Hmph, mock me all you want!\nIf you can mock me after seeing this fighting force!
Huh!?
Give Koto back!
Olmes, this time I'll crush you completely!
Louise the Zero, and Shirayuki.\nI'll be taking you prisoner.
How's that! How's that, Dejiko!!\nThis overwhelming force! The grand allied army!\nSurrender while you still can!!
I'm hungry, nyo.\nUsada, go buy me some bread, nyo.
Hah!? Are you half asleep?\nIs that it? Fine!\nI'll wake you up with a punch to the gut!
Come at me!!
(Dejiko, not flinching is admirable, but\nthis enemy lineup is on an unprecedented scale.\nWe don't have that much leeway...)
(And since we were ambushed,\nwe're forced on the defensive!)
(Ah, no problem, nyo.\nThe enemy has a decisive weakness,\nso this battle's a piece of cake, nyoo.)
Huh?
(The enemy's weakness is Usada, nyo.\nAs long as Usada's there, we can't lose, nyoo.)
O-hohohoho!!\nBehold! The beauty of this formation!\nOverwhelming, no!
How she gathered\nthis many people...
This groundwork... not to be underestimated.
She might be suited to politics.
Huh? Dejiko doesn't seem to be here?\nHey you lot! Where's Dejiko?
Oh, Dejiko-chan ran away.
Ran away?
She said something like 'no way we can win, nyoo'\nand wandered off somewhere.\nHonestly, what a handful.
Fufu... yes, she ran.\nIf that crafty Dejiko ran,\nit means she judged we can't win!
We won! This battle is won!\nEveryone! Advance and suppress!! Crush them!!
That was the plan from the start.\nI'll show anyone in my way some 'affection'!
Nice!\nSimple orders are easier!
...Overconfidence in numbers deserves no praise.
I'm the commander!\nSo Dejiko can't complain, it'll be a crushing victory at minimum!\nA crushing victory at maximum too!
...Understood.
//Battle start. The enemy advances aggressively.\n//Conversation event at the start of turn 2.
Ufufu! I'm on fire!\nWhy didn't I do this sooner?
What a smug face.
That B-tier idol vibe of getting carried away\nwithout even conquering anything\ngives me chills of admiration, desuu!
That's niche...
N-no, that's wrong, Char-san!\nMy strike zone is\nbetween C-tier and D-tier, desuu!
So\nI'd like her to fall a bit further, desuu!!
She'd be great for magic tricks!\nHypnosis would work on her in one shot.
In other words, she's an idiot.
At least say 'simple.'\nLike 'her heart is pure to an exasperating degree.' Y'know?
You're mocking her either way!
//Event when Yase and Koto clash (for the Yase ally flag).
Saying it up front! I'm not going back to the Mirror Capital!
Honestly! That, right off the bat?
But it's more fun than the Mirror Capital!
What's fun about it?
Isn't it fun for you, Yase?\nGoing all sorts of places, eating all sorts of things!\nFighting all sorts of stuff!
Because I'm not a child.
Don't adults find the same things fun\nas kids?
That's...
(Koto, you're really a good kid... I love you.)
//Yase's withdrawal line when defeated.
Tch, these mere humans are infuriating!\nI can't deal with this!
Huh? Why are you leaving!?
//Event when Riko and Aria clash.
Don't run, Olmes!
I don't recall ever running.\nUnlike you!
A phantom thief who doesn't run is a berserker!\nYou'd have to change jobs at some temple!
I'll get you changed into a convict right away,\nso rest easy!!
No thanks!!
//Event when Riko and Houki clash.
Mine Riko! Let's settle this!
Still using that lame IS?\nHow can you stand it?
What of its looks!
The performance is lame too.\nJust swinging a sword around like that,\nRiko says no way!
The sword is the soul of the samurai! Don't mock it!
//Event when Riko and Tiffania clash.
Oh my? Is that okayy?\nI'll catch youu?
I won't be caught!\nFor everyone's sake too...!
There's something big and jiggly\nthat looks easy to grab?\nKufufu, like a naughty game!
I-I won't lose!!
//Event when Riko is defeated.
I'm just off my game today!\nI'll be back!!
Huh!? Done already?\nAnd fast on her feet!?
//Event when Jeanne and Shirayuki clash.
Shirayuki, your place is not there.
Can you say the same?\nThat your place is with I-U?
Hmph, you've learned to talk back.\nBut it's just words.\nYour talent as a Choutei remains unpolished.
That's not...!
You're naive. With such half-hearted fighting,\nyour latent potential can never be drawn out.\nI think it's time you understood that.
Jeanne...!
//Event when Jeanne and Louise clash.
Your magic seems in fine form, Louise the Zero.
If you think so, run along.\nI'll blast you away!
I'm not like a mage who can only use magic.\nYou should refrain from rash actions.
Mind your own business!\nBeing able to use both sword and magic\njust makes you half-baked!
You call the Silver Ice of Orleans and the holy sword Durandal\nhalf-baked?\nThen try me!
//Event when Jeanne is defeated.
Such a planless battle goes against my principles.\nI'm done.
Ehh!? You're leaving!?\nTry a little harder!
//Event when any of Riko, Yase, or Jeanne is defeated. Tesla and Nine appear.
This changes the flow.
We can do this, right?
Ugh, this is bad!\nAt this rate I'll be a loser again!
...Just kidding.
Hm?
I haven't shown all my cards yet!\nCome on out! My secret weapon!!
//Tesla and Nine appear.
Our turn.
...Commencing action.
Ah!!
The Twin Phantoms...!
We're betting everything on this battle!\nI told you! A crushing victory!
You think you've won with this much?\nHow naive!
Say what you like.\nNow, resume the advance and suppress!
(Why didn't she deploy\nher full force from the start...?)
(She probably thought it'd somehow\nmake her look smarter...)
(She's just an idiot!)
//Event when Tesla and Red Angel clash.
Um, how many times have we met now?
...That hardly matters right now.
I feel like we've met a lot.\nIs that just me?
Tch... I don't recall that.
(To say this isn't awkward would be a lie...!\nBut!)
//Event when Nine and Red Angel clash.
Hey, why are you two fighting?
I can't believe you're fighting for no reason.\nPlease, tell me...
A reason...
//Nine's spirits drop.
You're looking well for someone just recovered!
Huh... how do you know that?
Fufu, losing focus over this much?\nYou've got a long way to go.
Hah!?\nTch, but just who are you...?
//Event when Nine and Blue Angel clash.
...Nice moves.
Huh?
...No holding back.
Just what I want!
//Event when Tesla and White Angel clash.
Hmph, so you're the Twin Phantom?\nSorry, but as long as I'M here,\nyou won't be throwing your weight around!
Oh my, still a childd.\nBut I won't hold back?
Hmph, I wonder if you'll be saying the same thing later?
Quite confident, aren't youu?\nThen let me see what you can do!
Bring it on!!
//Event when Nine and White Angel clash.
Twin Phantom or whatever you are,\nget in my way and I won't hold back!
Hmph, ignoring me takes guts.
...I don't like arguing.
Oh, we get along then. But...\nif you won't talk it out, we've got no choice but to fight!
//Event when Tiffania clashes with either Tesla or Nine.
Um, hello!\nI'm Tiffania!
Long time no see.\nI may owe you an apology first.
Why?
Because I promised to guarantee your safety,\nyet I put you in danger.\nI apologize for that.
But as for standing on this battlefield\nas enemies now,\nI don't intend to hold back.
That's simply a difference of positions.
But...!
...If you don't want to fight, you should stand down.
//Defeating either Tesla or Nine makes both withdraw.
We're withdrawing, Nacchan.\nWe've done enough!
...Understood.
What!? Hang in there a little longer!\nYou both leave at once... sheesh!
//Event when two of Yase, Riko, Jeanne, or Tesla & Nine are defeated, or when approaching within a set distance of Usada. Puchiko appears.
The enemy formation is in disarray!
Push them back! Everyone!
Hold on a sec!\nI still have a trump card!!
What is it?
Come on!!
//Puchiko appears near Usada, flanked by grunts on both sides.
Nyu.
That's Puchiko-san!
The hostage they kidnapped\nfrom Gamers!
That's a no-noo.
I don't want to resort to this either!\nMy crushing-victory plan got ruined,\nso I have no choice!
You're bad at fighting, nyu.\nIf Puchiko commanded, it'd be a piece of cake, nyu.
Silence!\nA hostage should just beg for help!
Beg for help silently?\nHow do you do that, nyu?
That's... um, well... like,\nmake a sad face or something?
Try it, nyu.
Huh, me? Fine,\na princess begging for help is like...
//Dejiko appears near Puchiko.
Eye beams!!
//The grunts near Puchiko are defeated.
Huh?
Puchiko! I came to save you, nyo!
You're late, nyu. Reflect on that, nyu.
Dejiko!? Didn't you run away!!
I can't believe how dumb Usada is\nto believe that, nyo...
Impossible...!
How you manage to fight\nwith such lousy command, nyo.\nUsada, apologize to your allies, nyo!
Why should I!?
Look, nyo! Leaving your guard wide open like this\nand showing off the hostage is basically saying\n'please come rescue her,' nyo!!
That's... I've got my reasons too!
So what'll you do, nyo? Puchiko's saved,\nand all that's left is getting hit by\nmy angry eye beams. Anything else, nyo?
What makes you think you've won?\nYou think I'd lose to Dejiko?
Then it's a one-on-one, nyo!\nDejiko is angry too, nyo!!
Bring it on! Let's do this!
That settles it-\nleave Usada to me, nyo!
Make sure you take her down responsibly, nyu.
// Event triggers when Dejiko and Usada engage in combat
Prepare yourself, Dejikooo!!
I'm honestly moved by how dense you are,\nstill thinking you can win, nyo!\nYou've already lost, nyooo!!
If I take you down, I win!!
// Defeat condition changed: Dejiko being incapacitated is added
Nyo!? Don't go changing the rules on me, nyo!?
Shut up! I'm the commander here!!
This is insane, nyo!!
// Defeating Usada clears the map
Awwn, why'd I have to loseee!!
// If any enemies besides Usada remain, they all disappear
Sniff... everyone's gone...
Usada, how pitiful, nyo.
// Battle ends\n// Background: Symphogear
Mooou!! Why can't I ever win!
// Event CG: a frustrated Usada
I was SO sure I'd beat Dejiko this tiiime!!
I worked sooo hard!\nI was everyone's errand girl,\ngave shoulder rubs and massages!
And that's how I finally got put in charge\nof the plan, and got people to fight with me!
I spent every point I earned\nto take on this huge showdown!!\nWhy'd I have to loseee!!
Usada, there's only one reason you lost...\nAnd it's hopelessly simple, nyo.
// Event CG off
The reason I lost...?
It's this...
You picked the wrong friends to hang out with, nyo.
Huh, uh...?
Those guys are terrible people, nyo!\nHanging around with the likes of them,\nof course you'd turn out no good, nyo!

I mean, taking Puchiko hostage
is so not you, nyo!!
You lose because you do stuff
that doesn't suit you, nyo!
Sniff... Dejiko... you're really smart...
As long as you get that, nyo.\nWhat you do has gotta be more fun,\nor it's no fun for me either, nyo!
Repent, nyu!
Waaah, Dejikooo! Puchikooo!
Well, I suppose that settles that?
Yeah.
But the situation's still full of problems.
Yes... hopefully we can get\nsome useful information out of Usada.
We could get attacked here again.\nShouldn't we move somewhere else?
Right, then shall we head to Dokoka Town?
// Fade to black\n// Background: Dokoka Town
...I see.\nSo Usada got talked into taking down Dejiko\nand went along with it, huh?
That's right... um,\ncould you not call me 'Usada', please?
Er, then, RabiiennRose.\nWho was it that talked you into it?
A girl about elementary-school age.
Huh? An elementary schooler?
Not Riko or Jeanne?\nOr maybe the Shinigami Doctor in disguise.
No, one day a little girl\nwith a school backpack\ncame up and talked to me.
She said she'd lend me her strength\nto defeat Dejiko.
And you just went right along with it, nyo?\nYou're such an idiot, nyo.
At first I thought it was a joke.\nI mean, you wouldn't think\na little kid like that could do anything.

Then she handed me a little box,
saying if I had it I could go
to all kinds of worlds-
so help her friends there.
By friends you mean Riko and Jeanne?
Yeah. At first it was just little errands.\nLike, walk down this road,\nor go see what's around that corner.
Oh, and there was one to keep an eye\non that elf girl over there.
Huh? Me?\nSo that means you've had dealings\nwith Twin Phantom too.
Yeah. But the only one\nI got friendly with was Riko.
Idiot, she was just using you!\nRiko obviously thought of you\nas nothing but an errand girl!
...Yeah, I figured.
You said you received a small box?\nYou still have it?
It's right here... hmm? Huh?\nI put it in this pocket...?\nDid I drop it somewhere???
As I thought-\nit must vanish if you betray them,\nso no evidence remains.

But I wonder whose world's
technology that is.
Something scientific?
Or something magical?
Its connection to the Polyal concerns me too.\nI wonder what's producing the power\nto move between worlds...
If only Eve were here, maybe...
Gone, as I expected, I suppose.
So Eve really was connected\nto how fast the enemy moves?

The enemy, who shouldn't have known
our destination, was lying in wait
when we arrived.
And in Eve's world, no less.
We got attacked in a cave\nwe wandered into by chance\nat our hot-spring trip destination.
But there's no proof\nthat happened because information\nleaked from Eve...

Eve's the one who taught us how
to use the Polyal stone...
So maybe using the Polyal
tells the enemy where we're going?
What about the possibility\nthat Eve, like Usada, was given something\nand was communicating through it?

I can't say it's impossible,
but if that were the case,
would she really have taught us
how to use the Polyal?
Haven't you heard anything from Eve?
Nooo...
No.
// Meru or Noel runs off.
Wait! We're not done talking!
Kanzaki, I'll go.
Tsubasa, please.
// Fade to black\n// Background: forest
Teacher...
Teacher...
How do you feel about Eve right now?
I don't wanna say...
Everyone's mad, right...?
...I don't know about everyone else,\nbut I believe in Eve.
Huh...
You believe in her? Why?
Partly because she saved my life,\nbut the biggest reason is you.
Meee?
Me? Why?
Eve's like a mother to you, isn't she?\nCould someone like that\nreally be your enemy?
If it were me, I'd take you along.\nI mean, if Eve told you to come with her,\nyou'd leave us and go with her, wouldn't you?
Yeees...
Yeah.
And yet Eve left you behind without a word.\nThere must be some reason she did that.
What kind of reason...?
What kind of reason, I wonder?
I'm no great detective,\nbut I think that reason is a mystery\nwe absolutely have to solve.
It's not a mystery we can solve right now,\nso let's start with what we can do.\nThat way, we'll surely see Eve again.
Tsubasa...!\nYou're right!\nMoping around won't get us anywhere!
Start with what we can do, huh.\nYeah!\nThere's plenty we need to do!
Thank you for cheering me up, Tsubasa!
Thanks, Tsubasa! I feel better now!
...Tachibana could probably support you\nbetter than I can, but I've known you\nthe longest, so...
Yeees!
We've been teamed up quite a while, huh!
// Fade to black\n// Background: black
Tsubasa's really trying!\nHehe, that Tsubasa...!
Peeping is in poor taste, Hibiki.
You're peeping too!
Aria, you too!
// Fade to black\n// Background: forest
(I know you're there...\nI'm just too embarrassed to say anything...)
I'll give it my all!
If I'm all down in the dumps\nit'll just make people more suspicious!\nI'll be more fired up than ever!!
(Teacher... someday, surely, again...!)
(Teacher, I believe in you!!)
//END
